spanish: Y levantó el atrio alrededor al mishkán y al altar, y dio el masaj de la puerta del atrio. Y acabó Moisés la obra.

findings.issue: H4908 is a common noun (morph Ncmsa), rendered as the untranslated Hebraism mishkán instead of a Spanish common noun.
H4539 is a common noun (morph Ncmsc, covering/screen), rendered as the untranslated Hebraism masaj instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens: hiphil 3ms raised the court around, qal 3ms gave the gate-screen, piel 3ms Moisés finished the work.
